# FILE_MAP: every file in web/src and web/tests

*Audit 2026-11, branch `audit/2026-11` off `main` at `5fd701d`. The columns Kind, Imports, Imported by, Tests and Dead are generated by `web/scripts/audit/graph.mts` from the code (TypeScript AST, `@/` and relative specifiers, static, dynamic `import()` and re-exports). "What it does" and Notes were written by reading each file in full.*

Regenerate the generated columns:

```
cd web && npx tsx --tsconfig scripts/tsconfig.json scripts/audit/graph.mts graph.json
```

## Summary

- Source files: **364** (server 117, client 94, shared 153); Next.js entry points (page, layout, route): 74.
- Test files: **112** `*.test.ts` (plus fixtures, helpers and transcripts under `web/tests`).
- No test reaches **110** source files, even transitively.
- **Cycles** (static value imports): `src/components/canvas/parts/ContentDisplay.tsx` <-> `src/components/canvas/parts/index.tsx`; `src/lib/ote/packager.ts` <-> `src/lib/ote/reader.ts`.
- **No importer in the app**: `src/components/chat/applyOps.ts`, `src/lib/ai/applier.ts`, `src/lib/ote/co-build.ts`, `src/lib/ote/demo-project.ts`, `src/lib/realtime/check.ts`. Of these, only `src/components/chat/applyOps.ts` is reachable from nothing at all; the others are used only by `web/scripts` or by tests (see each row).
- **Reading depth.** Streams S2 to S5 read every file in their lists in full. S1 read the core format and ops path in full (`core/ops`, `lib/ote/reader.ts`, `packager.ts`, `bindings.ts`, `schema.ts`, `databases.ts`, `fidelity.ts`, `preflight.ts`, `lib/backend/**`, the import and export routes, `lib/collab/changes.ts`, `lib/server/repo-live.ts`, `proposals.ts`); for its other files, including its 48 test files, it read the header comment and exports, so those rows describe the file, not every line.
- Kind: **server** = an API route, a `"use server"` file, or a file that reaches a Node/server package (`mongodb`, `node:*`, `next/server`, `bcrypt`, `@vercel/sandbox`, `jose`, Auth.js); **client** = `"use client"`; **shared** = neither.
